svg.title: Glossary of the terms inside BMad files
svg.desc: A card per file type, coloured by the agent that writes it, each listing its terms with a short meaning. Abbreviations: AC, AD-n, CAP-n, E2E, FR-n, I/O, MVP, NFR, PRD, PRFAQ, SM-n, UJ-n, UX, UX-DRn. Cards for shared terms, product brief and PRFAQ, research, PRD, UX design, architecture spine, epics and stories, sprint status, spec, Build story file, code review, retrospective, sprint change proposal, project context, and brainstorming and forge. The full definitions are in the tables on this page.

g.text: What you read inside BMad files, grouped by the file and coloured by the agent that writes it.
